raw_text: BOOM Fact Check: A video claiming to show 'breaking' artillery exchanges along the Line of Control in May 2024 is actually from February 2019. Our reverse image search traced the original upload to a news broadcast from the Balakot strikes era. Metadata analysis confirms the video was recorded in February 2019. Neither the Indian Army nor Pakistan's ISPR has reported any recent shelling along the LoC. The video is being shared with false context.
clean_text: BOOM Fact Check confirms viral LoC video is from February 2019 Balakot era. Reverse image search and metadata verify original date. No official reports of recent LoC shelling.
